intro: São Tomé and Príncipe are volcanic islands on the equator in the Gulf of Guinea.

chapters.title: Islands
text: Pico Cão Grande, a needle of volcanic rock, rises 300 m above the rainforest. The Ilhéu das Rolas islet lies right on the equator. Many birds and plants are found nowhere else.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The climate is hot and humid.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of São Tomé and Príncipe's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
